per_phase_nfrs.availability: 99.9% — review scheduler must be highly available to prevent missed regulatory review dates

security.data_classification: Confidential — client identity and review trigger reasons
security.access_control: Review queue accessible only to PER-052 and designated KYC team
security.audit: All review triggers logged with source (scheduled | event_triggered) and timestamp

per_phase_nfrs.availability: 99.5% — secure client portal must be available for document upload

security.data_classification: PII + Highly Confidential — identity documents, ownership structures, source of funds
security.access_control: Documents encrypted at rest and in transit. Accessible only to assigned analyst and PER-052.
security.audit: All document uploads logged with timestamp, document type, and analyst actions

per_phase_nfrs.throughput: Support concurrent document uploads from multiple clients during peak review cycles

latency.sanctions_screening_p99: < 30,000ms (real-time, but processing time for multiple UBOs)

per_phase_nfrs.availability: 99.9% — screening must not create bottleneck in CDD workflow

security.data_classification: Highly Confidential — sanctions and PEP screening results
security.access_control: Screening results restricted to compliance team. Sanctions hits flagged to MLRO immediately.
security.audit: All screening runs logged immutably with inputs, outputs, and timestamp (OFSI compliance — GOV-005-R02)

latency.decision_sla: 3 business days after risk assessment complete
latency.senior_manager_approval_sla: 1 business day for exit escalation decisions

security.access_control: Decision recording restricted to PER-052. Exit decisions require PER-059 digital approval with audit trail.
security.audit: Review decisions logged immutably: decision maker, timestamp, rationale, approval chain

security.data_classification: Highly Confidential — CDD records retained under MLR 2017
security.access_control: Archived records accessible only to compliance and senior management
security.audit: Full lifecycle archived (7 years — bank policy)

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: CDD Record Retention
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: All CDD records (documents, screening results, decisions, audit trail) retained for minimum 5 years (MLR 2017 Regulation 40). Bank policy extends to 7 years.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: Regulatory minimum is 5 years. Bank policy extension provides buffer for regulatory investigations and litigation.

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: Review Completion Rate
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: 100% of scheduled CDD reviews must be completed by their due date. SLA breach triggers compliance incident.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: Failure to conduct timely CDD reviews is a criminal offence under MLR 2017.

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: Sanctions Screening Latency
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: Sanctions screening must complete within 30 seconds per entity screened. Maximum 10 UBOs per corporate entity.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: OFSI requires prompt screening. Delays in CDD reviews that are caused by screening latency must not result in review deadline breaches.

regulatory_slas.name: MLR 2017 — Periodic CDD Review Frequency
regulatory_slas.requirement: PEP/high-risk clients: annual review. Standard-risk clients: review at least every 3 years. Risk-based determination required.
regulatory_slas.source: MLR 2017 Regulation 28 + FCA Financial Crime Guide
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: Criminal liability for bank; FCA supervisory action; potential licence revocation

regulatory_slas.name: OFSI — Sanctions Hit Notification
regulatory_slas.requirement: Notify OFSI within 14 calendar days of identifying a confirmed designated person

regulatory_slas.name: MLR 2017 — Record Keeping
regulatory_slas.requirement: CDD records retained minimum 5 years from end of business relationship
